what_it_does.text: WORK SYSTEM NORWAY AS is registered as AS – Aksjeselskap in Oslo, with main activity 46.640 – Engroshandel med maskiner og utstyr ellers.

Its own website describes it as: Work System tilbyr et bredt sortiment av smarte innredningsløsninger og bilutstyr, der majoriteten er designet og/eller produsert i Sverige. Den svenske opprinnelsen gjenspeiles i kvalitet, holdbarhet og sikkerhet.
Leadership on the register: CEO Benedikt Wiesmann; board chair Benedikt Wiesmann.
Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01/2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 17 930 394, net income NOK 255 614 (as filed, not estimated).

what_changed.text: Most recent dated activity: 2026-03-19 – Approved annual accounts (Godkjente årsregnskap).
First observation in this store: there is no earlier snapshot to compare against yet.

what_is_unknown.text: Hiring: no job posting found – the company's website links no careers page.

synthesis.text: WORK SYSTEM NORWAY AS is registered as AS – Aksjeselskap in Oslo, with main activity 46.640 – Engroshandel med maskiner og utstyr ellers. Its own website describes it as: Work System tilbyr et bredt sortiment av smarte innredningsløsninger og bilutstyr, der majoriteten er designet og/eller produsert i Sverige. Den svenske opprinnelsen gjenspeiles i kvalitet, holdbarhet og sikkerhet. Leadership on the register: CEO Benedikt Wiesmann; board chair Benedikt Wiesmann. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01/2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 17 930 394, net income NOK 255 614 (as filed, not estimated). Operating revenue went from NOK 10 737 904 (2024-01-01/2024-12-31) to NOK 17 930 394 (2025-01-01/2025-12-31) (+67.0%). Most recent dated activity: 2026-03-19 – Approved annual accounts (Godkjente årsregnskap). First observation in this store: there is no earlier snapshot to compare against yet. Unknown: Hiring: no job posting found – the company's website links no careers page.

claims.label: Registered activity

Regnskapet skal gi grunnlag for skattelegging og avgiftsberegning og en planmessig næringsdrift med en oversikt over medlemmenes økonomi. Regnskapet skal videre kunne danne grunnlag for drifts- analyser og driftsplanlegging. Videre skal laget bistå medlemmene i eventuelle klagesaker i for- bindelse med skattelegging og i forståelse med medlemmet utforme svar på forespørsler.

what_it_does.text: THUNE GULLSMED & URMAKER AS is registered as AS – Aksjeselskap in Oslo, with main activity 47.770 – Detaljhandel med ur, klokker og smykker.
Its own website describes it as: Thune Jewelry & Watches er en av Norges ledende bedrifter innen gullsmed- og urmakerbransjen med historie tilbake til 1857. Ler mer her
Leadership on the register: CEO Erling Bjerke; board chair Erling Bjerke.
Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01/2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 242 540 847, net income NOK 9 974 079 (as filed, not estimated).

what_changed.text: Most recent dated activity: 2026-08-15 – Approved annual accounts (Godkjente årsregnskap).
First observation in this store: there is no earlier snapshot to compare against yet.
Hiring: 1 job posting(s) listed on its own careers page when checked (Butikkmedarbeider deltid).

synthesis.text: THUNE GULLSMED & URMAKER AS is registered as AS – Aksjeselskap in Oslo, with main activity 47.770 – Detaljhandel med ur, klokker og smykker. Its own website describes it as: Thune Jewelry & Watches er en av Norges ledende bedrifter innen gullsmed- og urmakerbransjen med historie tilbake til 1857. Ler mer her Leadership on the register: CEO Erling Bjerke; board chair Erling Bjerke. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01/2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 242 540 847, net income NOK 9 974 079 (as filed, not estimated). Operating revenue went from NOK 224 307 152 (2024-01-01/2024-12-31) to NOK 242 540 847 (2025-01-01/2025-12-31) (+8.1%). Most recent dated activity: 2026-08-15 – Approved annual accounts (Godkjente årsregnskap). First observation in this store: there is no earlier snapshot to compare against yet. Hiring: 1 job posting(s) listed on its own careers page when checked (Butikkmedarbeider deltid).
